items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Pat' multiple times (e.g., 'But do you know what I'm trying to say, Pat...'). There is no mention of a third person named Pat.

ctx.x: Well, he liked you very, very much. I mean there was a closeness that I saw, but that of course was later.
But do you know what I'm trying to say, Pat, is he was a very hard man to know where you actually stood with him.
